entities.name: Specify normalized core artifact
entities.summary: Define the canonical checked representation, identity rules, source correspondence, and assumption encoding.

acceptance: Normalization is deterministic and documented
Every entity and obligation has stable identity
Source correspondence and assumptions are explicit
The format is independent of Rust, Lean, MLIR, and Wasm

entities.name: Design lossless incremental frontend
entities.summary: Specify immutable source trees, stable identities, recovery, query invalidation, and source-to-core provenance.

acceptance: Formatting and malformed source remain representable
Typed views do not become the canonical source tree
Incremental query inputs and invalidation rules are explicit
Diagnostics trace through elaboration to source ranges

entities.name: Design agent-facing kernel JSON
entities.summary: Freeze recursive JSON as the stable agent-facing kernel interface: raw documents, an explicit checked observation recorded by the 0018 checker seam, one JSON Schema, strict boundaries, and storage independence.

acceptance: Raw documents carry no inferred fact and no storage detail
The checked view makes binder context and judgments explicit
The strict decoder and the 0018 checker remain the authorities
Any internal storage change is observationally invisible

entities.name: Specify Lean evidence adapter
entities.summary: Define obligation translation, imported assumptions, proof identity, and independently checked result envelopes.

acceptance: Each translated obligation references an exact semantic identity
Trusted translation steps and imported axioms are visible
Proof artifacts can be cached independently of source layout
Failure cannot silently degrade into an assertion

entities.name: Define relational fact export
entities.summary: Specify stable facts for dependencies, effects, ownership, obligations, evidence, and source correspondence.

acceptance: Facts are derived from canonical artifacts
Recursive queries cannot mutate canonical state
Schema evolution and provenance are explicit
At least one impact and one evidence query are demonstrated

entities.name: Specify translation-validation seams
entities.summary: Identify transformations that must emit certificates, equivalence checks, or auditable correspondence data.

acceptance: Trusted and untrusted transformation boundaries are enumerated
Each boundary states its validation relation
Validation failures are reproducible and source-linked
Optimization infrastructure remains replaceable

entities.name: Specify semantic attestation profile
entities.summary: Map project evidence records to transport-neutral statements, signatures, provenance, and verification results.

acceptance: Evidence category is distinct from verification policy
Subjects and predicates are content-addressed
Assumptions and producer environment are explicit
The payload can be transported without making OCI or Sigstore semantic authorities

entities.name: Research semantic contracts to WIT mapping
entities.summary: Determine which interface, resource, ownership, and capability information can cross a Wasm component boundary without losing project semantics.

acceptance: Representable and non-representable contract dimensions are listed
Generated interfaces retain a link to the full semantic contract
Resource and capability boundaries are explicit
No claim is made that WIT carries laws or proof evidence

entities.name: Design deterministic concurrency simulator
entities.summary: Specify schedules, traces, actor mailboxes, transaction attempts, retry wakeups, and counterexample replay.

acceptance: Actor and STM semantics share a reproducible trace vocabulary
Schedule choices are explicit inputs
Counterexamples can be replayed exactly
Production runtime guarantees are not inferred from simulation alone

entities.name: Specify explorer query contract
entities.summary: Define recursive navigation, view projections, provenance, filtering, and introspection without coupling the UI to storage internals.

acceptance: Recursive components can be expanded and collapsed
Architecture, semantic, evidence, and work relations remain filterable
Every result links to canonical source identities
The API is read-only and storage-independent

Defines facts and recursive derived relations.
